usage: Refers to a person who works in an office, usually doing clerical, admin, or support tasks.
Commonly used for general job descriptions; it sounds neutral and natural in everyday Cantonese.
Can be modified with numbers or adjectives, for example to talk about a full-time office worker or a new office worker.
Often appears in workplace, HR, and job-hunting contexts when describing staff roles.
